- File: scripts/claude_issue_route.py
  Location: ARM_CHECK_IN_REQUEST_RE at line 875-878 (the parser regex)
  Issue: The session-id branch accepts `[A-Za-z0-9]{10,64}` but does not enforce the minimum length observed in production. The fix is a one-line tightening of the regex's minimum length to 24 to match the observed `session_01LkiqZoHfSm6HZF8n8Dogo1` (26 chars after `session_`) shape; the test at tests/test_claude_issue_route.py:660 uses 26 chars, so the test fixture still passes.
  Suggested minimal fix: change `[A-Za-z0-9]{10,64}` to `[A-Za-z0-9]{20,64}` and add a parametrized rejection case for `session_abcdef12`.
  HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
- File: .claude/commands/claude-issue-pickup.md
  Location: Step 5.2 (line 67)
  Issue: Step 5.2 says "If it fails twice" but does not specify the per-attempt timeout; if `create_session` hangs, the pickup can sit on the call for the whole MCP timeout before retrying, lengthening the wake. A bounded retry timeout (e.g., "if the call does not return within 60 seconds, count it as a failure") would bound the worst case.
  Suggested minimal fix: append "Treat any non-response within the MCP's per-call timeout as a failure for the retry counter." to the step 5.2 instruction.
  HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
